security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self'; script-src 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: A lightweight menubar app for Filen cloud sync
bundle.longDescription: Filen Menubar is a lightweight system tray application that wraps the Filen CLI to provide sync status monitoring. It runs in your system tray and shows the current sync state.
